entities.name: diner seated at a table in the 望楼饭铺 shed's east end
entities.what: Customer of the eatery shed (a man in a light, loose robe with his hair in a small dark topknot or cap), seated on the low bench S2.prop.shed_bench_28740, hunched forward to the east with both forearms resting on the table S2.prop.shed_table_28806; he faces east, toward the man holding the donkey.
entities.vis: part: feet behind the bench's legs
entities.note: Strokes: head u 28750-28779, v 556-579 (topknot at the top, face turned east); hands at u 28774-28786, v 586-602 on the table's west edge; the bench and a stool-like seat under him at u 28706-28774, v 606-655. Feet est at the front (east) foot of his seat, (28775, 642-650); a small shoe-like stroke there. Painted height 91 px seated at foot v 648 (the round-faced man next to him is 132 px seated, the man on the bench at the east end 117 px). The restyle draws him the same (light robe, blue cap, on a bench), and adds two or three more people at the table east of him (u 28800-28870): the scan has only the round-faced man S2.fig.donkey_owner_seated_28850 there. Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_man1.jpg, g_man1.jpg, g_shed1.jpg, inspect_28790_600.jpg.

entities.name: low bench under the seated diner
entities.what: A low wooden bench in the shed's east end, set at a slant (its west end farther back), on which the diner S2.fig.shed_diner_seated_28772 sits; possibly a long bench with a separate stool at its east end.
entities.vis: part: the seat hidden under the diner's robe
entities.note: Seat edge from about (28708, 608) down to (28772, 630); legs at (28712, 635), (28747, 655) and (28766, 655). OTHER READING: two seats, a slanting bench at u 28706-28745 and a stool at u 28741-28771 (v 624-655). SCALE CUE: seat to feet about 25-30 px at foot v 635-655. Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_man1.jpg, g_man1.jpg.

entities.name: table in the shed's east end
entities.what: A small table just east of the shed post at u 28790, on whose west edge the seated diner rests his forearms; the round-faced man with the donkey sits with his back half turned to its east side.
entities.vis: part: behind the shed post and the round-faced man
entities.note: Top bars u 28790-28822 at v about 578-582 with a lower rail at v 617-620; a leg-like vertical at u 28807-28812 down to about v 640. Hard to separate from the shed's posts (u 28787-28798, structures_e's) at this size; the diner's hands rest at u 28774-28786, v 586-602, so a table must stand here. The restyle draws a table here with dishes. Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_round.jpg, c_man1.jpg, g_table.jpg.

entities.name: round-faced man holding the donkey's lead
entities.what: A stout, round-faced, smiling man (traveller or the donkey's owner) in a light long robe and a dark cap, seated at the shed's east end on the stool S2.prop.shed_stool_28871, facing the viewer with his body turned east; his hands, held forward at chest height, hold a line (the donkey's lead rope, or a long stick) that runs east to the head of the dark donkey S2.ani.donkey_dark_28921; his robe spreads in a wide fan over his knees to the ground.
entities.vis: part: feet under the robe's hem
entities.src: 名画记: 城乡交界处 (pin 10)
entities.note: Strokes: head u 28822-28850, v 540-565 (face front, smiling); hands at about (28866, 580); the line from his hands runs (28868, 580) -> (28900, 587) -> (28926, 588), reaching the top of the donkey's dark neck. A second, diagonal line crosses his body from about (28802, 580) to (28862, 640): a staff he holds, or the edge of a bench (both readings). The robe's hem fans out at u 28817-28885, v 635-680; foot est at the hem's middle. Painted height 132 px at foot v 672: large for a seated man (the diner west of him is 91 px), so OTHER READING: he stands, his legs inside the long robe (the bend at v about 610 and the fanned hem read as seated). The restyle draws a woman in red seated here and a second man behind him (u 28800-28815): only this one figure is painted. Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_round.jpg, g_round.jpg, c_shedE_nogrid.jpg, c_back.jpg.

entities.name: stool under the round-faced man
entities.what: A small stool at the shed's east end, mostly hidden under the round-faced man's robe.
entities.src: 名画记: 城乡交界处 (pin 10)
entities.note: Seat edge at about v 610, legs at u about 28860 and 28882 down to v about 640 (strokes u 28857-28885, v 610-640). If the man stands (see his note), this is not a stool and is dropped. Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_round.jpg.

entities.name: dark donkey at the shed's east end
entities.what: A dark (black or dark brown) donkey, or a small horse or mule, standing at the east end of the 望楼饭铺 shed facing west, its head held high toward the round-faced man who holds its lead, one foreleg stepping forward; no saddle or load shows (the man in the light robe leans over its back); tail hanging at the east end.
entities.src: 名画记: 城乡交界处 (pin 10)
entities.note: Strokes: the dark neck rises from the chest at about (28915-28935, 640-650) to the head at about (28927-28954, 576-590), where the lead line from the round-faced man ends; body u 28946-29007, v 624-660 (back about v 622-627); forelegs: one stepping forward, hoof at (28908, 681), a fainter one at about (28935, 670); hind legs at u 28963-28972 (hoof v 679) and u 28985-28994 (hoof v 690); tail at u 28994-29007, v 630-653. SCALE CUE: chest to rump about 90 px, back to ground about 62 px at hoof v 676-690, beside men whose seated heights are 91-132 px: donkey-sized. The species is not certain (no ears read at this size): donkey, or a small dark horse or mule. OTHER READING of the rising dark mass: a person in dark clothes bending over a smaller dark animal (a dog or a pig) whose body is u 28946-29007; the lead line ending on the mass's top and the forward-stepping leg favour one donkey. The setup's brief reads a rider on it: the man in the light robe sits behind it on a bench instead (his robe stops at the donkey's back line and no leg crosses its dark flank; see S2.fig.man_leaning_over_donkey_29000). The restyle turns the donkey into two men (one in blue squatting with a stick, one bending): only the donkey is painted. Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_rider2.jpg, c_rider_nogrid.jpg, c_rider_z5.jpg, g_donkey.jpg, inspect_28950_610.jpg.

entities.name: man in a light robe on a bench, leaning over the donkey
entities.what: A bearded man in a light long robe with a dark head-cloth, seated on the low bench S2.prop.bench_29030 just behind (north of) the dark donkey, bending far forward to the west over its back with both hands at its neck, his face turned toward the viewer; the donkey's owner or a customer of the shed.
entities.vis: part: legs and feet hidden behind the donkey's rump
entities.src: 名画记: 城乡交界处 (pin 10)
entities.note: Strokes: head u 28973-29004, v 528-556 (dark head-cloth, dark beard at u 28985-29000, v 545-552); back curves east to u 29029 at v 541-597; hands at u 28962-28984, v 563-574 at the donkey's neck; the robe ends at v about 625-627 on the donkey's back line. His seat is the bench at u 29008-29052 (top v 600-610); feet est west of it behind the donkey's rump. Painted height 117 px seated (head to est foot). OTHER READING (the setup's brief): a rider astride the donkey. Against it: no robe or leg crosses the donkey's dark flank below its back line, his seat-to-head height (about 75 px to the bench, 98 px to the donkey's back) matches the seated customers (63-80 px) only if he sits on the bench, and the bench stands right under his hips. If he rides, his support becomes animal S2.ani.donkey_dark_28921, pose riding, foot est (28975, 684). Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_rider2.jpg, c_bench.jpg, g_shed3.jpg, c_rider_nogrid.jpg.

entities.name: low bench at the shed's east end, under the leaning man
entities.what: A low wooden bench with splayed legs at the east end of the 望楼饭铺 shed, just west of the seam with the village stalls; the man leaning over the donkey sits on it.
entities.vis: part: west end under the man
entities.note: Top from (29008, 600) to (29052, 610); legs at (29016, 628), (29024, 626) and (29047, 630). SCALE CUE: about 25 px from seat to feet at foot v 630. Its east end touches u 29050: it is S2's by its base (u 29030), but it may belong with S1's first stall: the S1 merge should check it against its stall furniture (seam note in the report). Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_bench.jpg, g_bench.jpg, g_shed3.jpg.

entities.name: trestle furniture (or a wattle fence) under the far roof at the top
entities.what: Faint crossed and upright sticks under the eave of the long building at the top of the silk: the crossed legs of trestle benches or tables in its open front, or a low wattle fence along it.
entities.note: Strokes u 28687-28750, v 85-122: verticals and zigzag diagonals ('IWNI'), under the far roof's eave (v about 85; the roof v 22-85 is structures_e's). Too faint at native resolution to tell furniture from a fence; no head is readable among them, so no figures. If a fence, it is structures_e's and this is dropped. The restyle draws two small bare trees and a post here (and a well house at u 28800-28880). Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_top1.jpg, c_top_a.jpg, g_topstrip.jpg, inspect_28760_100.jpg.

entities.name: small bare tree (or a post) in front of the far roof
entities.what: A thick slanting dark stroke with a fork or crossbar at its top, standing in front of the far building at the top of the silk: a small bare tree, or a post with a bracket (a well sweep's post?).
entities.note: Stem from (28872, 87) down to (28880, 125), slanting; crossbar or fork u 28858-28886 at v 75-87, at the far roof's eave line. THREE READINGS: a small bare tree (the restyle's), a post or bracket of the far building (then structures_e's and this is dropped), or the frame of a well (the restyle draws a well house just west of it at u 28800-28870). Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_top_b.jpg, g_top_b.jpg, g_topstrip.jpg, inspect_28900_100.jpg.

entities.name: rounded low object in front of the far building
entities.what: A low, rounded, elongated object on the ground in front of the far building at the top: a tub, a trough, or a jar lying on its side.
entities.note: Outline u 28905-28940, v 98-113, just west of a post at u 28940-28960 (structures_e's). Could be a low bench or the foot of the building's wall. The restyle draws a low stone block or opening here. Crops: scratchpad S2_t12/c_top_b.jpg, g_top_b.jpg, g_topstrip.jpg.

entities.name: the diner at the table in the shed's east end
entities.what: A customer of the 望楼饭铺 shed seated on a low bench, leaning on a small table and looking east at the donkey scene.
entities.note: Part of the long 望楼饭铺 shed's customers (≈ 28250-29000); t11 holds the shed's customers west of u 28700. The merge may join this group to t11's shed group.

entities.name: the donkey at the shed's east end (城乡交界处)
entities.what: At the east end of the 望楼饭铺 shed, where the canal wharves end and the village stalls begin, a round-faced man seated on a stool holds the lead of a dark donkey that stands facing him with its head up, while a bearded man on a bench behind the donkey leans over its back with his hands at its neck: travellers resting with their animal.
entities.src: 名画记: 城乡交界处 (pin 10)
entities.note: Pin 10 (u 28940) sits on the donkey. The setup's brief read 'a rider on a dark horse or donkey'; the strokes read better as the man seated on the bench behind the donkey (see the figures' notes for both readings).
